flags.why: “Gạo trộn lẫn chạ nhiều loại” is not a natural Vietnamese construction.
flags.fix: Quần áo của mọi người để chung chạ trong một cái tủ. = Everyone's clothes are mixed together in one cupboard.

flags.why: This word belongs to formal contexts of public honour or elevation, as described in the [dictionary entry](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/suy-ton-eX77CwhNmPIja.html).
“Chốn an toàn” means a safe place, whereas the translation makes safety describe the journey.
flags.fix: The passengers reached a safe place.

flags.why: “Đương sự” is a formal administrative or legal term rather than an ordinary casual label for someone involved.

The human label is disparaging rather than a neutral word for a spotter or informant, consistent with the usage described by [VTC News](https://vtcnews.vn/thuc-hu-quan-niem-dan-gian-ve-tieng-chim-lon-keu-ar767193.html).
Calling someone “chim lợn” for spreading gossip is derogatory.
The entry omits the common meaning of doing work carelessly or perfunctorily, recorded in the [dictionary entry](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_en/B%C3%B4i_b%C3%A1c).
flags.fix: to do carelessly or perfunctorily; shoddy — Đừng làm ăn bôi bác như thế. = Don't do such shoddy work.
